visual_name: Day in the life, part thirty eight: three songs, many times (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js narrowboat cabin (cut away at the front: plank floor, cream walls, wood panelling, brass portholes showing rain then sun on the canal, a green settee, a galley with a stove and kettle, a spice rack, an ironing board, a wall lamp), box-built creator with a red beanie, beard, Breton stripes and cord trousers, an accordion whose bellows squeeze, jars that hop into alphabetical order, steam puffs, ironed socks piling up, phone sheets for a brand's welcome email / his notes with three empty steps / the YourBrand Home next-step card (2 of 4 steps done, Sign the agreement, Continue) / the neighbours' note, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 39.7 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: on a narrowboat, he got approved for a campaign. Huge. So he descaled the kettle, alphabetized his spices, ironed his socks and learned three songs on the accordion: one video to make and no idea where to start, so he didn't. Then YourBrand: Home shows exactly where he is, two of four steps done, sign the agreement next, one button: Continue. No kettle, no socks, no bullshit. He kept the accordion. The neighbours left a note.
